_extraction_flags.notes: Valid Experimental Paper. Integrated Optical Sensing and Communication (IOSAC) using a Silicon Nitride (Si3N4) Micro-Ring Resonator for simultaneous Refractive Index Sensing (Salinity) and 1.25 Gbps OOK Communication over 20 km Fiber.

reasoning_trace.step_0_visual_inspection: Fig 1: Setup with ASE, Modulator, 10km+10km fiber, Si3N4 Chip, OSA, BERT. Fig 2: BER vs Received Power and Resonance Shift vs Salinity.
reasoning_trace.step_1_concept_analysis: System: Fiber-Sensing (IOSAC). Sensing: Refractive Index (Salinity) via Resonance Shift. Comm: OOK (IM-DD). Method: Si3N4 Micro-Ring Resonator acts as both a passive filter/sensor and transmission element.
reasoning_trace.step_2_benchmark_verification: Comm: 1.25 Gbps OOK. Sensing: 294 nm/RIU sensitivity. Fiber: 20 km total.
reasoning_trace.step_3_strategic_critique: Focuses on ocean monitoring (salinity) integrating sensing into submarine-like fiber links. Si3N4 ring provides high Q and sensitivity.

bibliographic.title: Simultaneous Sensing and Communication Over 20 km Fiber Based on Si3N4 Micro-Ring
bibliographic.authors: Ving Qiu, Xiangpeng Ou, Ming Luo, Chao Yang, Zhixue He, Xi Xiao, Yan Yang, Jin Tao

application.scenario_description: Submarine cable monitoring (salinity) using micro-ring resonator integrated into optical fiber communication link.

key_contribution.key_contribution: Si3N4 Micro-Ring Resonator used for simultaneous biochemical sensing (Salinity/RI) and data transmission over 20km fiber.
key_contribution.gap_addressed: Difficulty of biochemical sensing (e.g. salinity) using standard all-fiber links.

transmitter.notes: ASE filtered to 5nm, then modulated. Resonance at ~1597-1599nm.

receiver.notes: PD for BER, OSA for Sensing (Spectrum Analysis).

integration.notes: Signal passes through the sensor chip. Spectrum shift indicates sensing, transmission carries data.

waveform.notes: Modulated light is used to probe the resonance shift.

channel_fibre.notes: 20 km SMF (10km pre-chip, 10km post-chip). Sensing happens at the discrete chip.

comm_metrics.notes: 1.25 Gbps OOK. BER degrades from 10^-5.6 (DI water) to 10^-4.1 (Salt water) at -10dBm.

sensing_metrics.notes: Refractive Index Sensing Sensitivity: 294 nm/RIU. Resonance shift ~1.9 nm for 3.5% NaCl.

tradeoff.notes: Presence of analyte (Salt Water) causes ~2 dB power penalty / BER degradation.
